build_learner_for_launchpad: build a learner builder that prepares the example learner to run on launchpad with a dataset lookup
build_example_learner: build an example learner with init, train, and predict callbacks using a dataset lookup function
init_learner_state: initialize an empty frozen ExampleLearnerState dataclass instance for the baseline learner
train_example_learner: train the example learner on a dataset and return zero resource usage as a baseline
predict_classifications: predict zero-filled outputs for classification or multi-label classification tasks from a dataset
